decisions.reason: As a nearby extension of the established decorative range, the music box is worth keeping because it offers learning about demand for technology-enhanced items while its likely carrying cost is moderate and the first year gives too little evidence to abandon it.

The nativity stable fits the firm's core seasonal wooden craft business very closely, uses existing capabilities, and in a growing market there is little reason to close this low-uncertainty, low-cost option after only one season.

The modern incense smoker should be kept because it is a relatively inexpensive probe into the firm's strategic move toward more contemporary designs, and one launch year is not enough to judge whether customer acceptance will build.
